# Getting help with Trend & Tend Server

- **Questions about Trend & Tend:** start with the [FAQ](https://wrinklebyte.com/trend-tend-faq.html).
- **Help with the apps or your account:** see [wrinklebyte.com/help](https://wrinklebyte.com/help.html).
- **Running your own server:** follow the [self-hosting guide](https://github.com/wrinklebyte/trend-tend-server#self-hosting-production) in the README.
- **Found a bug in the server or web app, or want a feature?** [Open an issue](https://github.com/wrinklebyte/trend-tend-server/issues/new) with your version (shown by `GET /health`), how you run it, and the steps to reproduce.
- **Security problem?** Don't open a public issue. Contact us privately through [wrinklebyte.com/help](https://wrinklebyte.com/help.html).

More about Trend & Tend and WrinkleByte: [wrinklebyte.com](https://wrinklebyte.com/products.html).
